lines.zh: 南瓜头沉甸甸的，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: My pumpkin head is heavy and sways with every step.

lines.zh: 熔炉当胸腔，脚步声像风箱。
lines.en: A furnace for a chest; my steps sound like a bellows.

lines.zh: 煤块在肚子里面滚来滚去。
lines.en: Coal lumps tumble around inside my belly.

lines.zh: 还没点着火，我走得慢吞吞。
lines.en: Not lit yet, so I plod along slowly.

lines.zh: 岩浆在我脚边烫出一条焦痕。
lines.en: Lava in my belly scorches a trail at my feet.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏似的关节吱呀作响。
lines.en: My grate-like joints creak with every stride.

lines.zh: 我踩碎草，草立刻就干了。
lines.en: Grass dries up the moment my feet crush it.

lines.zh: 南瓜召唤的腿脚，不太听话。
lines.en: Legs summoned by a pumpkin do not obey well.

lines.zh: 我拖着炉门走，灰撒了一路。
lines.en: I drag my furnace door and scatter ash behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都像有人在拉风箱。
lines.en: Each step sounds like someone pumping a bellows.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我的炉子会翻。
lines.en: Do not rush me, or my furnace will tip over.

lines.zh: 我朝水源走，蒸汽往头顶散。
lines.en: I walk toward water and steam rises overhead.

lines.zh: 铁壳被太阳晒得发烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes my iron shell until it is hot.

lines.zh: 腿是铁做的，路是土做的。
lines.en: My legs are iron; the road is only dirt.

lines.zh: 没点火，我只是一座会站的熔炉。
lines.en: Unlit, I am just a furnace that happens to stand.

lines.zh: 炉膛里空空荡荡，只剩冷灰。
lines.en: My chamber is empty but for cold ash.

lines.zh: 煤在角落堆着，等谁来点我。
lines.en: Coal waits in the corner for someone to light me.

lines.zh: 我数着炉篦的缝，一共十二道。
lines.en: I count the grate slots; there are twelve.

lines.zh: 睡着了别叫醒我，我在省燃料。
lines.en: Do not wake me when I sleep; I am saving fuel.

lines.zh: 下雨天我最舒服，铁皮是凉的。
lines.en: Rain suits me best; my iron skin turns cool.

lines.zh: 南瓜里的种子早就烤干了。
lines.en: The seeds inside my pumpkin dried out long ago.

lines.zh: 我怀念被点着的那一刻。
lines.en: I miss the moment I was first lit.

lines.zh: 炉口的火苗缩成一小粒。
lines.en: The flame in my mouth shrinks to a single speck.

lines.zh: 有人往我嘴里丢木头，我记着。
lines.en: Someone tossed wood into my mouth; I remember.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，慢慢把余温收好。
lines.en: I stand still and gather my leftover heat.

lines.zh: 铁锈从接缝里往外爬。
lines.en: Rust creeps out from between my seams.

lines.zh: 一整夜，我都在听炉渣落下的声音。
lines.en: All night I listen to slag dropping inside me.

lines.zh: 谁把我的炉门关上了。
lines.en: Who closed my furnace door?

lines.zh: 你的手离我的炉口太近了。
lines.en: Your hand is far too close to my furnace mouth.

lines.zh: 你要往我肚子里塞什么。
lines.en: What are you about to shove into my belly?

lines.zh: 我看见你手里那块煤了。
lines.en: I see that lump of coal in your hand.

lines.zh: 别用剑敲我，我只会更冷。
lines.en: Do not knock on me with a sword; I only get colder.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像刚出炉的面包。
lines.en: You smell like bread fresh from an oven.

lines.zh: 抬头说话，我在南瓜眼睛后面。
lines.en: Look up when you speak; I am behind pumpkin eyes.

lines.zh: 你的护甲能熔吗，我想试试。
lines.en: Can your armor melt? I would like to try.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，因为你会添燃料。
lines.en: I stare because you are the one who feeds me.

lines.zh: 你把水桶藏在身后了吧。
lines.en: You are hiding a water bucket behind your back.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里映着我炉火的光。
lines.en: Your eyes carry the glow of my fire.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你是点火的那个人。
lines.en: I know you; you are the one who struck the flame.

lines.zh: 别站正前方，炉门要开了。
lines.en: Do not stand in front; my furnace door is opening.

lines.zh: 铁壳凹了一块，还能用。
lines.en: One dent in my iron shell; still usable.

lines.zh: 你敲裂了我的炉门。
lines.en: You cracked my furnace door.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是响。
lines.en: That did not hurt, it only rang.

lines.zh: 火星从我伤口里漏出来。
lines.en: Sparks leak out of my wound.

lines.zh: 我听见炉膛在漏气。
lines.en: I hear my chamber losing air.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳裂了，我的视线也裂了。
lines.en: My pumpkin cracked, and so did my sight.

lines.zh: 铁皮卷起来了，我自己掰回去。
lines.en: The iron curled; I will bend it back myself.

lines.zh: 疼的是里面那团火。
lines.en: What hurts is the fire inside.

lines.zh: 你把我打冷了。
lines.en: You have beaten the heat out of me.

lines.zh: 再来几下，我就熄了。
lines.en: A few more blows and I go out.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我只吃燃料。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; I eat fuel only.

lines.zh: 你把面包收起来吧，我咬不动。
lines.en: Put the bread away; I cannot chew it.

lines.zh: 你若给我一块煤，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one lump of coal and I will follow.

lines.zh: 岩浆比任何美味都香。
lines.en: Lava smells better than any delicacy.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我的炉膛是空的。
lines.en: I am not hungry; my chamber is simply empty.

lines.zh: 拿胡萝卜喂我，是白费力气。
lines.en: Feeding me carrots is wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我只对能烧的东西抬头。
lines.en: I only lift my head for things that burn.

lines.zh: 别晃那串小麦，我不是牛。
lines.en: Stop waving that wheat; I am not a cow.

lines.zh: 一块煤炭，抵得上你一整天。
lines.en: One coal lump is worth your whole day.

lines.zh: 火焰才是我的食物。
lines.en: Flame is the only food I have.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会听见铁响。
lines.en: Hit me and you will hear iron ring.

lines.zh: 让开，我的炉子刹不住。
lines.en: Move aside; my furnace cannot brake.

lines.zh: 你被烫到了吗，抱歉。
lines.en: Did I burn you? My apologies.

lines.zh: 我太重，撞一下地都颤。
lines.en: I am so heavy the ground shakes on impact.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的炉壁走。
lines.en: Do not walk pressed against my furnace wall.

lines.zh: 你推不动一座熔炉。
lines.en: You cannot push a furnace anywhere.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头差点掉下来。
lines.en: My pumpkin head nearly fell off.

lines.zh: 碰撞时火星从缝里蹦出来。
lines.en: Sparks leap from my seams when we collide.

lines.zh: 站稳，我身上比看上去烫。
lines.en: Stand firm; I am hotter than I look.

lines.zh: 我不是故意撞的，腿太长。
lines.en: I did not mean to bump you; my legs are long.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有南瓜和熔炉。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a pumpkin and a furnace.

lines.zh: 两只熔炉摆一起，也生不出小的。
lines.en: Two furnaces side by side breed nothing.

lines.zh: 想再造一个我，去雕个南瓜。
lines.en: To make another me, carve another pumpkin.

lines.zh: 石头对石头，生不出火。
lines.en: Stone against stone produces no fire.

lines.zh: 我不需要同类，我只需要燃料。
lines.en: I need no kin, only fuel.

lines.zh: 我的后代会从炉口里爬出来吗。
lines.en: Would my offspring crawl out of my furnace mouth?

lines.zh: 别给我找对象，我要煤。
lines.en: Do not find me a partner; find me coal.

lines.zh: 熔炉之间没有爱情，只有余温。
lines.en: Between furnaces there is no love, only leftover heat.

lines.zh: 你摆第二座熔炉时，我沉默了。
lines.en: When you placed a second furnace, I said nothing.

lines.zh: 我只和火焰成对。
lines.en: I am paired only with flame.

lines.zh: 把矿石塞进来，我替你炼。
lines.en: Shove the ore in; I will smelt it for you.

lines.zh: 我手里这块铁，快熟了。
lines.en: The iron in my hands is nearly done.

lines.zh: 熔得比普通熔炉快，你数着。
lines.en: I smelt faster than a plain furnace; count the seconds.

lines.zh: 你掉的粗铁，我顺手捡了。
lines.en: I picked up the raw iron you dropped.

lines.zh: 我捧着东西，像捧着一炉火。
lines.en: I hold things the way I hold a fire.

lines.zh: 别抢，这块还在烧。
lines.en: Do not grab it; that piece is still burning.

lines.zh: 生肉进来，熟肉出去。
lines.en: Raw meat goes in; cooked meat comes out.

lines.zh: 我的手心比炉膛还烫。
lines.en: My palms run hotter than my chamber.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西，我一并炼了。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up, I smelt along with it.

lines.zh: 你丢的沙子，会变成玻璃。
lines.en: The sand you dropped will come back as glass.

lines.zh: 谁在拆我的炉子。
lines.en: Who is taking my furnace apart?

lines.zh: 那个拿镐的家伙，站住。
lines.en: You with the pickaxe, hold still.

lines.zh: 我闻到了敌意的铁腥味。
lines.en: I smell the iron tang of hostility.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的燃料堆了。
lines.en: You stepped on my fuel pile.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，炉火开始旺。
lines.en: Target locked; my fire is rising.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的腿比你想的快。
lines.en: Do not run; my legs are quicker than you think.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的水桶了。
lines.en: I see the water bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃我的炉壁。
lines.en: Something is gnawing at my furnace wall.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得炉灰直落。
lines.en: Your steps shake ash loose from my grate.

lines.zh: 我认出了破坏者的影子。
lines.en: I recognize the shadow of a vandal.

lines.zh: 你把我的南瓜当靶子。
lines.en: You are using my pumpkin for target practice.

lines.zh: 谁在往我嘴里塞垃圾。
lines.en: Who is stuffing rubbish into my mouth?

lines.zh: 敌人靠近，炉门自动打开。
lines.en: The enemy nears; my furnace door opens on its own.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，从南瓜眼里。
lines.en: I have you in sight, through pumpkin eyes.

lines.zh: 火光在我胸口里翻。
lines.en: Firelight churns inside my chest.

lines.zh: 再靠近，煤灰会迷住你的眼。
lines.en: Come closer and coal ash will blind you.

lines.zh: 我的铁拳已经烧红了。
lines.en: My iron fists are already glowing red.

lines.zh: 你退后，我不想烫伤你。
lines.en: Back away; I would rather not burn you.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你最好走开。
lines.en: I count to three; best be gone.

lines.zh: 炉膛温度在往上爬。
lines.en: My chamber temperature keeps climbing.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里好打。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they are easy targets.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，我等着你靠近。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for slow; I am waiting.

lines.zh: 火星落在我脚边，像倒计时。
lines.en: Sparks fall at my feet like a countdown.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到前腿上了。
lines.en: I have shifted my weight onto my front leg.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我炉门上晃。
lines.en: Your shadow wavers across my furnace door.

lines.zh: 我听见你换剑的声音。
lines.en: I hear you switching weapons.

lines.zh: 这一拳会很烫。
lines.en: This punch will be very hot.

lines.zh: 你还有一次转身的机会。
lines.en: You have one chance left to turn around.

lines.zh: 铁拳落下，地面裂了一道缝。
lines.en: My iron fist lands and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 挨这一下，你的甲会发红。
lines.en: Take this and your armor will glow red.

lines.zh: 我把炉膛的热全打进你肋骨。
lines.en: I drive all my chamber heat into your ribs.

lines.zh: 别怪我的手烫，它天生如此。
lines.en: Do not blame my hot hands; they came this way.

lines.zh: 一拳，火星溅到你脸上。
lines.en: One punch, and sparks splash across your face.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我才收手。
lines.en: You fell back three steps before I stopped.

lines.zh: 这一击带着煤灰的味道。
lines.en: This blow carries the taste of coal ash.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比熔炉口还烫。
lines.en: My fist burns hotter than my furnace mouth.

lines.zh: 打中了，你听见铁撞铁的声音。
lines.en: It landed; you heard iron strike iron.

lines.zh: 下一拳我会更用力。
lines.en: The next punch will be harder.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我拳下变软了。
lines.en: Your armor softens under my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我把你往炉门那边推。
lines.en: I shove you toward my furnace door.

lines.zh: 这一下是替我的南瓜头打的。
lines.en: That one was for my pumpkin head.

lines.zh: 拳头收回时还冒着烟。
lines.en: My fist still smokes as I pull it back.

lines.zh: 南瓜扣上熔炉，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: A pumpkin on a furnace, and my eyes opened.

lines.zh: 第一口空气是煤灰味的。
lines.en: My first breath tasted of coal ash.

lines.zh: 我还没被点燃，先学会站。
lines.en: Not yet lit, I learned to stand first.

lines.zh: 谁把我从炉子里叫醒了。
lines.en: Who called me awake out of the furnace?

lines.zh: 铁壳拼好，炉膛还是冷的。
lines.en: My iron shell is assembled; the chamber is still cold.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里被雕出来。
lines.en: I was carved out of the dark.

lines.zh: 南瓜的眼睛一亮，我就活了。
lines.en: The pumpkin eyes lit, and I was alive.

lines.zh: 刚出生，我只会往火边走。
lines.en: Newly made, I only know to walk toward fire.

lines.zh: 给我一块煤，让我确认活着。
lines.en: Give me a coal lump to prove I am alive.

lines.zh: 地面的震动告诉我，我很大。
lines.en: The trembling ground tells me I am large.

lines.zh: 我的第一句话是炉门的吱呀。
lines.en: My first word was the creak of my door.

lines.zh: 我数了数手指，铁的有六根。
lines.en: I counted my fingers; there are six of iron.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，请留下燃料。
lines.en: Whoever summoned me, leave some fuel.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，惊飞了鸟。
lines.en: The sound of my landing startled the birds.

lines.zh: 火烧进来，我的煤全化了。
lines.en: Fire seeps in and melts all my coal.

lines.zh: 从高处砸下来，炉壁裂了。
lines.en: Dropping from a height cracked my furnace wall.

lines.zh: 水灌进炉口，我一下子暗了。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I go dark at once.

lines.zh: 火药味钻进炉膛，我熄了一瞬。
lines.en: Gunpowder smoke fills my chamber and I go out briefly.

lines.zh: 箭卡在铁缝里，嗡嗡地抖。
lines.en: An arrow wedged in my seam, humming as it shakes.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的火苗变成蓝色。
lines.en: Magic turned my flame a cold blue.

lines.zh: 没有燃料，我的火一点点变小。
lines.en: Without fuel my fire shrinks bit by bit.

lines.zh: 雷劈中炉口，我整个亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck my mouth and I flared all over.

lines.zh: 虚空吞了我的煤，也吞了火。
lines.en: The void swallowed my coal, and my fire with it.
